title: Ask a question that gets answered

steps.title: Search first
steps.body: Look for an existing thread before you post.

steps.title: Pick the right place
steps.body: Forum for questions, Feedback and Ideas for requests, a ticket for instance errors.

steps.title: Describe the goal
steps.body: State what you want to achieve and what you tried, without confidential or personal data.

steps.title: Stay relevant
steps.body: Keep it about Glean or the broader AI industry. No promotion.

steps.title: Close the loop
steps.body: Share what worked so the next person benefits.
